Questions

  
How do I know if a vendor's new bank details are real?

  
Call the vendor on a phone number you already had, such as one from an old invoice or your contract, not one in the email. Ask your usual contact to confirm the new details, and have a second person approve the change before paying.

  
What is business email compromise?

  
A scam where a fraudster sends an email that looks like it comes from a vendor or a manager, often from a hacked mailbox or a look-alike domain, and asks for a payment to a new account. It is one of the costliest kinds of online fraud reported to the FBI.

  
What should I do if we already paid?

  
Call your bank's fraud line right away and ask them to recall the payment, then report it at ic3.gov. Change your email passwords and tell the real vendor.
